'''Kov Du Derra''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] who worked as a [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] for the [[Ccalras Corporation]] representative [[Kollan Xa]] in [[Mos Eisley]] around the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. He wore [[Color/Legends|white]] overalls with black boots and highlights.

Around that time, he and Xa "kidnapped" [[Beeyon Nace]]'s lover [[Eila]] in order to blackmail the agent into reporting on customs patrols.

==Behind the scenes==
Kov Du Derra appears in [[West End Games]]' [[1997]] ''[[Mos Eisley Adventure Set]]''.
